firstPlayerRule: Players discuss who has performed the most impressive feat in their life. That player takes the My Round card and starts the game.
clarifications: Play proceeds clockwise during the Draft and Boast phases.
internalEvidence: The Spiral Galaxy Games publisher-authored English rulebook, preserved by Tesera, was rendered and visually checked. Its first page gives the impressive-feat selection, awards the My Round card, and describes clockwise Draft and Boast play.
